payout_quote: The $500 new account cash bonus offer ("offer") is available on any Penn Community Bank personal checking account type. To receive the $500 new checking cash bonus the account must be opened with $25 or more and complete one of the following within the first sixty (60) days of account opening: a) receive qualifying direct deposits totaling $1,750 or more to the checking account OR b) complete 20 or more debit card purchase transactions of $20 or more each that post to the checking account.
payout_value_note: Single-tier $500 cash bonus; no tier split. Distinct from the earlier $400 campaign (R2114, /400bonus/).
numeric_basis: Bonus $500; open with $25+; qualifying DD total $1,750+ within 60 days OR 20+ debit card purchases of $20+ each within 60 days; bonus deposited within 45 days after meeting requirements; account must be open/active/in good standing at processing.
timing: Bonus deposited to the checking account within 45 days after meeting offer requirements.
eligibility: New personal checking account at a Penn Community Bank Lehigh Valley or Montgomery County branch (Bethlehem, Allentown, Lansdale, Jenkintown PA) or online at www.PennCommunityBank.com/500Bonus. Prior-account exclusion, promo-code requirement, and expiration date are not stated in the retrievable official terms for this $500 campaign — confirm with the bank before applying.
steps: Open a new Penn Community Bank personal checking account with $25 or more at a listed Lehigh Valley or Montgomery County branch or online at www.PennCommunityBank.com/500Bonus.

Within the first 60 days of account opening, EITHER receive qualifying direct deposits (recurring electronic deposits of payroll, Social Security, pension, government benefits, or other eligible regular monthly income) totaling $1,750 or more, OR complete 20 or more debit card purchase transactions of $20 or more each that post to the account.
Keep the account open, active, and in good standing; the $500 bonus is deposited within 45 days after meeting the requirements.
Do not close the account within 6 months of opening: an early termination fee may apply and the bonus amount received will be debited from the final account balance.
catches: Requirements must be completed within the first 60 days of account opening — either $1,750+ in qualifying recurring direct deposits or 20+ debit purchases of $20+ each.

Qualifying direct deposits must be recurring electronic deposits (payroll, Social Security, pension, government benefits, regular monthly income); P2P/person-to-person-style transfers are not described as qualifying.
If the account is closed for any reason within 6 months of opening, an early termination fee may apply AND the $500 bonus is clawed back from the final balance.
The official terms do not state the bonus tax reporting, prior-account/new-customer exclusions, or an expiration date — confirm these with the bank before applying.
Available only through Lehigh Valley or Montgomery County PA branches or the online /500Bonus application — not at all branches.
biggest_catch: Complete the requirement within 60 days AND keep the account open at least 6 months — closing early can trigger an early termination fee plus full clawback of the $500 bonus. The official terms do not state tax reporting, prior-account exclusions, or an expiration date, so confirm those with the bank first.
